title: Assorted Storage
description: Adds chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, crates, bags and locks for all your storage.
body:
# Assorted Storage

> Starting with 12.0.0 every mod in Assorted Storage can be downloaded on its own or all together here in the bundle. The pages for the separate mods are still being reviewed, so some of their links may not work yet.

Adds storage of every kind. Chests, barrels, shulker boxes and hoppers in a pile of materials, crates that hold a lot of one item, bags to carry, cabinets and safes, and locks to keep it all yours.

![A crate wall with its controller, material chests under hoppers, barrels and shulker boxes, lockers, safes, cabinets and an item tower, bags and level upgrades framed above, and a locked chest by the locksmith workbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RY5hZOKH/images/0711c1eda02c6208672c06ac414a97e98d933074_350.webp)

## What's included

Each of these is also its own mod, if you only want some of them.

- [Assorted Chests](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-chests) adds chests in many materials that hold far more than a vanilla chest.
- [Assorted Barrels](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-barrels) adds barrels in many materials that hold far more than a vanilla barrel.
- [Assorted Shulkers](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-shulkers) adds shulker boxes in many materials that hold far more and keep it all when broken.
- [Assorted Hoppers](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-hoppers) adds hoppers in many materials that hold far more, and the better ones move items faster.
- [Assorted Crates](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-crates) adds crates that hold lots of one item, crate controllers and bridges, compacting crates, crate upgrades and the rotator majig.
- [Assorted Bags](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-bags) adds bags in many materials that you carry and dye, and the ender bag.
- [Assorted Containers](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-containers) adds cabinets, safes, lockers, item towers and warehouse crates.
- [Assorted Locks](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-locks) adds padlocks, keys, key rings and the locksmith workbench.
- [Assorted Level Upgrades](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-level-upgrades) adds level upgrades that raise a chest, barrel, hopper or shulker box to a better material in place.

You can turn any of them off in `config/assortedstorage-parts.toml` (`.json` on Fabric).

## Updating from 11.x

Worlds from 11.x keep all your blocks, items, recipes and everything stored in them. Settings from `assortedstorage-common.toml` need setting again, since each mod has its own config now.

## Requirements

- [Assorted Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/assorted-lib)
- NeoForge, or Fabric Loader with Fabric API

## More

The full guide with recipes is at [assortedmods.com](https://assortedmods.com/storage). It's also in the game, in the Instruction Manual from Assorted Lib.

Found a bug? Report it on [GitHub](https://github.com/AssortedMods/AssortedStorage/issues).
